page_title: DAR 0-6 HOF | Darmstadt v Hoffenheim 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' The Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Florian Badstubner rules it out for a foul.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
88' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
85' Substitution. Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ihlas Bebou walks off.
82' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
81' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Emir Karic will be replaced by Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt).
80' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
76' A goal, which was scored by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim), was disallowed due to offside.
75' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
75' A first-time shot by Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
74' The attendance is 17810.
73' Tim Skarke goes off the pitch and Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) comes on.
72' Substitution. Maximilian Beier did his best and is replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
72' Here is a change. Marius Bulter is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
71' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
71' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
70' The ball is cleared after Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' A precise short pass from Pavel Kaderabek releases Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.

64' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
61' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
59' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off the line to clear the ball away.
58' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

57' Oliver Baumann doesn't have to worry about this one. Tim Skarke plays a pass into the feet of Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
56' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Fabian Nurnberger is replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt).
56' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) is able to continue to play.
55' The game is interrupted now, Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
51' 0 - 6 Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alexander Brunst with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:6.
50' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Oscar Vilhelmsson comes off for Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Torsten Lieberknecht gives a chance to Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) and Mathias Honsak is off.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) replaces Ozan Kabak.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo makes a switch. Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is coming on in place of Anton Stach at the start of the second period.
46' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Great teamplay by Darmstadt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 5 Goal! Ihlas Bebou plays a long ball to Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:5.
41' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:5.
39' Florian Badstubner blows the whistle, Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is penalised for a foul.
37' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) picks up a long through ball, but Alexander Brunst deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
34' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
31' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.

26' 0 - 4 Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Andrej Kramaric. His header was precise and ended up in the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:4.
26' The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
25' Darmstadt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Darmstadt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' 0 - 3 What a goal that is! Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Alexander Brunst and into the net. 0:3.
22' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
16' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
15' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
11' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

8' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Florian Badstubner to decide. The relieved Hoffenheim players can finally celebrate. Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly fires the ball into the middle of the net.
7' Attention! Referee Florian Badstubner straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
6' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
6' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' 0 - 1 Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) collects a sweet pass and fires the ball inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
1' The first half has just begun.
Darmstadt will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
